versions.changelog:
baoyu-cover-image-2 v0.1.1

- No file changes detected in this release.
- Functionality and documentation remain the same as previous version.

baoyu-cover-image-2 v0.1.0

- Initial release of the article cover image generator skill, supporting 5 dimensions of customization (type, palette, rendering, text, mood).
- Supports 10 color palettes, 7 rendering styles, and multiple aspect ratios (cinematic 2.35:1, widescreen 16:9, square 1:1, and more).
- Includes command line options and workflow for auto-selection, confirmation, and integration of reference images.
- Provides full documentation and structure for usage, file output, and customization presets.
- Emphasizes user interaction for dimension confirmation and handling of reference images with people.
